lines.say: Med students. Two cards from the Test phase. Answer before they flip.
Intact uterus, oestrogen-only HRT, no progestogen. What's the risk?
Endometrial hyperplasia. If you said breast cancer, that's the trap.
Next. Sperm leave the epididymis. Where do they go next?
The vas deferens. Not the ejaculatory duct. That comes after.
Offload built both cards from uploaded lecture notes. Get one wrong, and it comes back sooner.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
